## Requirements (contract)

1. `obligation-event/1` + `coverage-assessment/1` schemas and a deterministic
   `current-projection/1` (JSON + Markdown) under `docs/build/reports/`.
2. Reconcile the four legacy status conflicts against linked evidence: old values/history
   preserved, ambiguous → OPEN; compatibility status cells update **only** with matching
   transition evidence.
3. `CURRENT.md` ≤ 250 lines / 20 KiB orientation view + link-out pages; all input hashes and
   stale-source status recorded; `LEDGER.md` remains the control authority.
4. Explicit acyclic input manifest + migration anchors; shadow mode before cutover, one status
   writer after (P32.8 / D-R10-MEMORY-1). Semantic payload timestamps are fixed inputs or
   separate receipts — no wall-clock inside deterministic payloads.
